Audit trail

Company log

A diary of notable studio events: hires, price changes, closures, incidents

Team accounts

Each person signs in with their own username & password. Assign a role to control what they can see and do.

Roles & permissions

Tap a page or permission to turn it on (green) or off. Add roles to match how your studio is staffed.

Theme & display

Adds The Label Board to your phone or desktop so it opens full-screen, like a normal app.
Change your password in My account.

What your studio does

Tick everything your business does. We'll show only the tools you need.

Making shows Production & fittings. Selling shows Stock styles & Sales. Tick both if you do both.
Leave this off if it is just you. These tools appear on their own once you add staff or a second studio.

How the owner is paid

Choose how you (the owner) take money out. New orders use this automatically, and you can still override a single order.

Notifications

sound & alerts

Storage

photos & documents

Company details

Used on invoices and receipts you send to customers.

none
Add an account per currency you collect in: Naira, Pounds, USD, Euro. All show on the invoice.

Message templates

Default wording for the messages you send clients. Use {client}, {order}, {balance}, {brand}. They fill in automatically.

Order defaults

Sensible starting values, used to pre-fill new orders so you type less.

All dashboards & totals show in this. Individual orders can still be invoiced in other currencies.

Branches & outlets

Add each shop, studio or outlet you operate. Orders, sales, expenses and staff can then be tagged to a branch.

Production workflow

The stages every order moves through. Tailor the making stages to how your studio works. Order Received opens every order, and Quality Check → Ready for Delivery → Dispatched → Delivered close it out. Those are added automatically.

Products & materials

Everything your studio makes or sells, each with the materials it can use.

Stock used per product (auto-deduct from inventory)

Set the materials each garment type uses, as a reference for what each piece consumes.

Quality control checklist

The checks your team ticks off before an order passes QC. One per line.

Loyalty tiers

A customer's tier is based on total spend. Name each tier and set the minimum to reach it.

Inventory categories

Tailor your stock categories to your studio. Tick production material for anything that goes into making an outfit (it feeds outfit costing). Add subcategories by typing them when you add an item.

Backup & restore

Your data lives only in this browser, so back it up regularly. Restoring the file on any device brings everything back exactly as it was.

Import old data

Bring your history across from another app, a spreadsheet or your old website. Columns are matched automatically, and re-importing updates records rather than duplicating them.

Data

Load a quick example to explore, or clear everything to start fresh.
